environment.limits: Single uncontrolled desktop host; OS filesystem cache is not flushed. Cold means empty tool disk cache, not cold OS/page cache. No simultaneous benchmark suites. No production CDN, Next.js or serverless measurement.

protocol: Seven interleaved rounds × three photographs × five SSR/hydrated Svelte cases. Fresh Chromium context per cold/warm pair; second navigation uses browser HTTP cache. Mobile 390x844 DPR2, CDP applied 100ms latency, 1.6Mbps download, 750Kbps upload, 4x CPU slowdown. Gzip HTML/JS/CSS, cache max-age=3600. Every case eager/high priority with preload and explicit dimensions; optimized cases must request one identical WebP by SHA-256. Imageway uses ordinary imports and explicit shared plugin settings (256/384/512/768, WebP+JPEG, q75, no placeholder); enhanced-img uses WebP q75 and same widths. Native responsive markup is extracted from Image SSR then compiled as a native Svelte element. Native original has the same layout/priority, loads lossless PNG. Resource transfer excludes the document. OS/host and Chromium scheduling are uncontrolled. No Next.js, service/CDN or production-site claim.
